AZX Card Challenge

Adventure across 15×15 fields in 60 steps, stop the card roulette, and unlock all 26 fighters. Card values, growth order and air-combo tiers come from the deck table at 0xF3F10 in the original cartridge.

How faithful is this? Field size (15×15), 60 steps, temples, Kurukuru card pickups, pits, rival unlocks, card-point leveling, the Level 9 Ogre World and the roulette card-stop are implemented as documented for the original game; the 75-byte-per-fighter card table, growth order and air-combo tiers are read from the cartridge. The strike/throw/guard triangle follows the documented rock-paper-scissors design; exact byte semantics are inferred. Fighters are original AZX characters. Link-cable play is not reproduced.
